# Alexa Plus
> Amazon Alexa is Amazon’s voice assistant platform for smart home control, devices, skills, and developer integrations.

Alexa spans consumer experiences on Echo devices and a broad developer platform for building custom skills, smart home integrations, and voice-enabled experiences. The most useful LLM-facing resources are hosted across Amazon Alexa developer documentation, API references, and related Amazon device and smart home pages.

## Main Site
- [Alexa Plus](https://www.amazonalexa.com/): Consumer landing page for Alexa and Alexa-enabled experiences.
- [Amazon Alexa App](https://www.amazonalexa.com/app): Information about the Alexa mobile app for setup and device management.
- [Alexa Devices](https://www.amazonalexa.com/devices): Overview of Alexa-enabled devices and Echo product experiences.
- [What Is Alexa](https://www.amazonalexa.com/alexa): Introductory information about Alexa features and capabilities.

## Developer Portal
- [Alexa Developer Home](https://developer.amazon.com/alexa): Entry point for Alexa developer tools, docs, and platform resources.
- [Build Alexa Skills](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/alexa/alexa-skills-kit): Overview of the Alexa Skills Kit for custom voice experiences.
- [Smart Home](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/alexa/smarthome): Resources for building Alexa smart home integrations.
- [Alexa Connect Kit](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/alexa/connected-products/alexa-connect-kit): Platform for building connected devices with Alexa.
- [Alexa Auto SDK](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/alexa/auto): SDK and tools for integrating Alexa into automotive experiences.
- [Alexa for Apps](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/alexa/alexa-for-apps): Tools for connecting mobile apps with Alexa experiences.

## Documentation
- [Alexa Skills Kit Documentation](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/ask-overviews/build-skills-with-the-alexa-skills-kit.html): Core documentation for designing and building Alexa skills.
- [Smart Home Skill API](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/device-apis/alexa-discovery.html): Device API documentation for Alexa smart home capabilities.
- [Skill Manifest Reference](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/smapi/skill-manifest-api-reference.html): Reference for defining skill metadata and interfaces.
- [Interaction Model Reference](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/custom-skills/create-the-interaction-model-for-your-skill.html): Guidance for intents, slots, and sample utterances.
- [Account Linking](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/account-linking/add-account-linking-logic-custom-skill.html): Documentation for linking Alexa skills to external user accounts.
- [Certification Requirements](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/custom-skills/policy-requirements-for-an-alexa-skill.html): Policy and certification requirements for publishing Alexa skills.

## APIs and References
- [Skill Management API](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/smapi/alexa-skills-kit-management-api-reference.html): API reference for creating and managing Alexa skills programmatically.
- [ASK CLI](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/smapi/ask-cli-intro.html): Command-line tooling for Alexa skill development and deployment.
- [Request and Response JSON Reference](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/custom-skills/request-and-response-json-reference.html): Schema reference for custom skill requests and responses.
- [APL Documentation](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/alexa-presentation-language/understand-apl.html): Reference for building multimodal Alexa visual experiences.
- [Events and Notifications](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/smapi/proactive-events-api-reference.html): API reference for proactive events and customer notifications.
- [ISP API](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/in-skill-purchase/in-skill-purchase-overview.html): Documentation for in-skill purchasing and monetization features.

## Guides and Tutorials
- [Create a Custom Skill](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/custom-skills/steps-to-build-a-custom-skill.html): Step-by-step guide to building a basic Alexa custom skill.
- [Build a Smart Home Skill](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/smarthome/steps-to-build-a-smart-home-skill.html): Tutorial for implementing smart home device control with Alexa.
- [Use the ASK SDK for Node.js](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/alexa-skills-kit-sdk-for-nodejs/overview.html): Guide to building Alexa skills with the Node.js SDK.
- [Use the ASK SDK for Python](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/alexa-skills-kit-sdk-for-python/overview.html): Guide to building Alexa skills with the Python SDK.
- [Host a Skill as an AWS Lambda Function](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/hosted-skills/alexa-hosted-skills-overview.html): Overview of hosted and serverless deployment options for skills.
- [Test a Skill](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/custom-skills/test-and-debug-a-custom-skill.html): Guidance for testing, debugging, and validating Alexa skills.

## SDKs and Tools
- [ASK SDK for Node.js](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/alexa-skills-kit-sdk-for-nodejs/overview.html): Official Node.js SDK for Alexa skill development.
- [ASK SDK for Python](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/alexa-skills-kit-sdk-for-python/overview.html): Official Python SDK for Alexa skill development.
- [ASK SDK for Java](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/alexa-skills-kit-sdk-for-java/overview.html): Official Java SDK for Alexa skill development.
- [ASK Toolkit for Visual Studio Code](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/ask-toolkit/vs-code-overview.html): IDE extension for building and managing Alexa skills.
- [Alexa Simulator](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/alexa/console/ask/test): Browser-based testing environment for Alexa skills.
- [Developer Console](https://developer.amazon.com/alexa/console/ask): Web console for creating, configuring, and publishing Alexa skills.

## Connected Devices
- [Works with Alexa](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/alexa/works-with-alexa): Program for certifying compatible smart home devices.
- [Smart Home Guides](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/smarthome/understand-the-smart-home-skill-api.html): Overview of smart home APIs, interfaces, and implementation patterns.
- [Alexa Connect Kit Docs](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/ack/ack-overview.html): Documentation for building connected products with Alexa Connect Kit.
- [Matter on Alexa](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/alexa/smarthome/matter): Resources for integrating Matter-compatible devices with Alexa.
- [Device Makers](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/alexa/device-makers): Programs and tools for Alexa-enabled hardware manufacturers.

## Publishing and Monetization
- [Publish a Skill](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/custom-skills/submit-a-skill-for-certification.html): Process for submitting Alexa skills for certification and release.
- [Skill Store](https://www.amazon.com/alexa-skills): Consumer marketplace for discovering published Alexa skills.
- [In-Skill Purchasing](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/alexa/in-skill-purchase): Monetization options for premium Alexa skill content.
- [Developer Rewards](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/alexa/alexa-skills-kit/developer-rewards): Information about Alexa developer incentive programs.
- [Policies and Guidelines](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/custom-skills/policy-requirements-for-an-alexa-skill.html): Content, privacy, and certification rules for Alexa skills.

## News and Updates
- [Alexa Developer Blog](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/blogs/alexa): Product updates, announcements, and technical articles for Alexa developers.
- [Alexa Events](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/alexa/events): Webinars, conferences, and community events for Alexa developers.
- [What’s New with Alexa](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/alexa/whats-new): Recent platform updates and newly released Alexa features.
- [Amazon Developer Home](https://developer.amazon.com/): Broader Amazon developer platform entry point with Alexa-related updates.
